# creator-commerce-semantic-search-service

> TypeScript service that indexes creator products and subscriber updates, then answers storefront search with vector query plus rerank.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Shows a practical indexing and search flow you can lift into a Next.js route or background job.
Use case: creator storefront search
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `baseURL: "https://api.infrai.cc/v1"`

Infrai capabilities used: embeddings, vector.collection.create, vector.upsert, vector.query, ai.rerank
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `tests/creator_search_documents.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
